venom-fang.words: a big green snake with a small gold crown resting in a loose coil by a mossy branch, looking pleased but pretending not to be, a young sloth with a satchel standing politely beside him asking first, a warm friendly visit in the rainforest

crocus-rex.words: a big crocodile with a crooked little crown swimming gently across the calm river like a ferry, three small passengers riding on his back, the tree village on the far bank, sunny

shadow-prowler.words: a black panther lying quietly on a mossy rock ledge in a glowworm cave in the evening, a young sloth sitting beside him, neither of them talking, both looking out, peaceful

sky-sovereign.words: a great harpy eagle flying free on the wind over the misty valley and waterfalls, two young grown eaglets flying with her, the wind blowing where it likes

tarantula-queen.words: a big friendly tarantula queen with a tiny crown at a little round table set for tea among the pink orchids, a china teapot and cups, a young sloth guest sitting with her finishing his cup

marsh-reaver.words: a big marsh creature sitting on a mangrove root by a path at noon eating his lunch from a leaf, half of it left beside him, fireflies, clean still water

stone-golem.words: a mossy stone golem speaking slowly at a council in the ancient ruins, every stone chair in the ring taken by forest guardians listening patiently, sun through the trees

night-wing-monarch.words: a huge night butterfly monarch perched on a branch under the moon writing in a little book, a young sloth beside her telling her how a dream ended, fireflies

magma-drake.words: a red dragon at a tidy little table by the volcano with two used teacups, two young sloths visiting him, a girl sloth in a pink headband and a boy sloth with a satchel, his cave swept neat and tidy, warm glow

general.words: an old brown sloth in a rust red scarf and no armour planting a small young tree on the riverbank in spring, kneeling patiently, taking his time, gentle morning light

soldiers.words: two tired soldier sloths in green coats sitting down at a wooden counter in a little tailor shop, relieved to sit, a measuring tape on the counter, warm lamp light

squirrels.words: a family of red squirrels under the old vine in the rainforest laughing and waving, little kids, a new blank wooden sign on a post beside them, sunny

gruntlewick.words: an old marmoset town crier with a white beard reading a brand new warning from a scroll in the tree village, very serious about it, proud

mailman.words: a sloth mail carrier with a cap and a mail bag carrying a parcel very carefully and seriously through the tree village, taking his time

pell.words: a sloth lieutenant in his own little tailor shop sewing at the counter, a crooked wooden shop sign, customers waiting happily, warm lamp light, a busy friendly shop

flicker.words: a small glowing firefly hovering steady over a wooden shop counter, a warm steady light over the counter, a quiet tailor shop at night
